```
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: final seated first-person background for an original modern Chinese village adventure game; 16:9 landscape 1920x1080.
Input image 1: the repaired shelter location and Zhou character identity reference (shelter-complete). Input image 2: modern village landscape and morning light reference (village-day).

This is the actual seated perspective, not a picture of an empty bench and not an overhead view. Camera eye height about 1.15 metres, level horizon, stable fixed composition.
Composition: broad open view of the quiet damp stone village lane in the center and left, low stone wall with bamboo fencing, white-plaster homes with dark tiled roofs, scattered modern electric wires, soft green mountain slopes and lifting pale mist. Shelter roof beams frame the top naturally and one timber post at the side; bench is against the shelter wall behind us. Near the bottom edge a SMALL section of the warm worn wooden seat, the protagonist's gray-blue sleeve, a closed plain paper travel notebook and a corner of a small outdoor backpack provide first-person seating cues without obscuring the road. No readable writing.
Zhou: the SAME gray-haired elderly craftsman from reference 1 sits NEXT TO the protagonist on the right, only in the far-right 15-20% of the composition. Natural side/three-quarter profile and upper torso partly cropped at the edge, modest friendly relaxed expression looking toward the village road. Same angular aged face, gray short hair, plain navy work jacket and light gray undershirt; natural human scale. Keep his face a SMALL supporting detail, not a giant foreground portrait or central character shot. No other people.
Style: match the exact crisp hard-edged anime/game illustration style of the references, clear contour lines, shaped shadows, convincing weathered wood and stone texture, natural proportions; tasteful painterly environment, not photo, not toy-like 3D, not soft chibi.
Lighting/mood: calm next morning after rain, clear gentle sky, diffuse sunlight, damp stone reflections and fresh greenery. Quiet sense of having finished a helpful task, simple everyday warmth.
Constraints: preserve location identity, furniture materials and modern village details. No text, logos, UI, captions, panels, watermark or border. Do not place a second complete empty bench between the camera and the road. No camera at standing height, overhead angle, protagonist full-body or close-up face.
```
